exposure: age groups (35-39 years, 40 years and older)
advanced maternal age (35 years and older)
cohort: 517 women aged 35 years and older who gave birth between 2009 and 2010 at the Bolu Izzet Baysal Maternity and Children's Hospital in Turkey
finding: Advanced maternal age was associated with increased cesarean sections, neonatal mortality, premature birth, and low birth weight.
